title: 第2章 梦中得传承
slug: 修炼狂潮全本免费-修炼狂潮最新章节列表
content_zh:
尤其是要在高三分班之前，跨入肉身境第七重，才有机会考上武科班，修炼武技也是会分摊了修炼内功的时间，减少考上武科班的希望。
因此早些年很多家长都站出来，要求学校剔除学习武技的课程，为了不让自己的孩子分心，浪费时间。
而且这些学生成年之前，都会生活在基地市里，基本也没什么危险，学了武技用处也不大。
不过到了现在就不同了，一个月后就是分班考试了，此时可以说已经成了定局了，考得上就考得上，考不上的的就考不上，也就无所谓了。
武道修行，内功只是一半，剩下的一半就是武技的修炼，一个会武技的武者能够击败一个不会武技，但是境界比自己高的人。
所以武技的修行，也同样很重要，没有人会忽视！
当然，也不是所有人都没有修行武技的，因为这也不是强制性的要求，有些天赋高的，恐怕已经开始修炼武技了。
楚云凡扫了一眼诸多同学，果然有些人不为所动，应该都是修行过武技的，而这些人基本都是班级里最有天赋的那一批人了。
基本上都是铁定能进武科班的，最差的都是肉身境第七重的。
不过对于楚云凡来说，还是很兴奋的，从小他也没能接触到武技，虽然他知道，现在这年头要学武技很简单，一些低级的武技，在网上都可以学的到，只要付出一些金钱就可以了。
但是他都克制住了自己的冲动，一方面是因为心知自己的天赋一般，本来打坐练功的时间就不够了，如果还去修炼武技，就更没希望考上武科班了。
二来也是不想浪费金钱，反正学校里会教的。
秦武在说了下课之后，就很快离开了，也不拖堂，也不愿意在这里浪费时间。
整个教室一下子都哗然了起来，许多人都在讨论明天秦武会教什么样的武技，毕竟大部分人都没有学过武技，心中难免兴奋。
讨论了一会儿，所有人都开始起身收拾东西，今天的课程结束了，他们都要回家了。
楚云凡起身，也开始到角落收拾起了书包，准备回家了，又一天过去了。
“踏踏踏踏！”
一阵脚步声传来，却见是一个身材肥胖的少年，年纪与楚云凡相仿，一身本来就宽大的武道服都快被他给撑爆了。
不过虽然看着肥胖，但是实际上他的脚步轻便，一路急促的飞奔而至，却是脸不红心不跳，也是有一身修为在身的。
这是楚云凡少数几个好友之一，高宏志，一个名副其实的高富胖。

他太了解自己的这个损友了，虽然一身修为在身，比他强多了，居然已经是肉身境第九重的修为，在那些能进武科班的同学中也是佼佼者，但是平时的行为就和他肥胖的外表完全一致，能坐着就不站着，能不动就不动。
虽然他的肥胖是因为先天的肥胖基因，但是总是让人忍不住连想，这丫的根本就是因为懒才胖成这样子的吧。
两人无论是家世还是天资都差太远了，本来应该是两个不会交集的平行世界，偏偏在高中两年里处的很好，臭味相投。
“还不是科学院的超古代遗迹巡回展览有一部分将会放在我们学校展出呢，你平时不是对超古代文明的事情最有兴趣么？不去看看？”高宏志道。
“超古代文明的遗迹？好啊，我们去看看！”高宏志说的事情也提起了楚云凡的兴趣。
当楚云凡和高宏志两人来到学校专门开辟的展览区的时候，早已经是人山人海，静海市十三中虽然只是静海市数十所中学中很普通的一个，但是全校师生加起来也有上万人之多，简直就是一个小型的城镇，而现在这些人都朝着展览区而来，可想而知，这得堵成什么样子。
在大灾变之后，对于超古代文明的研究和发掘，复原也成了整个社会的主流，政府也会经常将一些不是那么重要的超古代文明的遗迹四处展览。
这一次巡回展出到十三中的超古代文明的遗迹，仅仅只是这一次巡回展示的超古代文明遗迹之中很少的一部分罢了。
楚云凡和高宏志两人随着人流缓缓移动着，楚云凡的目光盯着这些锁在了钢化玻璃中的展品，有超古代文明的石刻，也有残缺的兵器等等，虽然是文物，但是实际上价值却不是很高。

content_en:
Especially before the third grade of high school, you have to enter the seventh level of the physical realm to have a chance to be admitted to the martial arts class. Practicing martial arts will also take up the time of practicing internal strength, reducing the hope of being admitted to the martial arts class.
Therefore, in the early years, many parents stood up and asked schools to eliminate martial arts courses in order to prevent their children from being distracted and wasting time.
Moreover, these students will live in the base city until they reach adulthood. There is basically no danger, and the martial arts skills learned will not be of much use.
But it's different now. The placement test will be in one month. It can be said that it is a foregone conclusion at this time. If you can pass the exam, you will pass, and if you can't pass, you will not pass, so it doesn't matter.
In martial arts training, internal strength is only half, and the remaining half is the cultivation of martial arts. A warrior who knows martial arts can defeat a person who does not know martial arts, but has a higher level than himself.
Therefore, the practice of martial arts is also very important, and no one will ignore it!
Of course, not everyone has not practiced martial arts, because this is not a mandatory requirement. Some people with high talents may have already begun to practice martial arts.
Chu Yunfan glanced at the many classmates. Sure enough, some people were unmoved. They must have practiced martial arts, and these people were basically the most talented people in the class.
Basically, they are all guaranteed to enter the martial arts class, and the worst ones are those at the seventh level of the physical realm.
But for Chu Yunfan, it was still very exciting. He had not been exposed to martial arts since he was a child, although he knew that it is very easy to learn martial arts these days. Some low-level martial arts can be learned online, as long as you pay some money.
But he restrained his impulse. On the one hand, he knew that his talent was average and he would not have enough time to meditate and practice. If he continued to practice martial arts, he would have no hope of being admitted to the martial arts class.
Secondly, I don’t want to waste money, since it will be taught in school anyway.
After Qin Wu said get out of class was over, he left quickly without dragging the class or wasting time here.
The whole classroom was in an uproar. Many people were discussing what kind of martial arts Qin Wu would teach tomorrow. After all, most people had never learned martial arts, so they were inevitably excited.
After discussing for a while, everyone started to get up and pack their things. Today's class is over and they are all going home.
Chu Yunfan got up and started to pack his schoolbag in the corner, ready to go home. Another day passed.
"Tap tap tap tap!"
There was a sound of footsteps, and it turned out to be a fat young man, about the same age as Chu Yunfan, and his already roomy martial arts uniform was almost bursting from him.
However, although he looked fat, he was actually light on his feet and rushed all the way. His face was not red, his heart was not beating, and he also had a lot of cultivation.
This is one of Chu Yunfan's few friends, Gao Hongzhi, a real tall, rich and fat man.
He knew his bad friend very well. Although his cultivation was much stronger than him, he was already at the ninth level of the physical realm, and he was also the best among those students who could enter the martial arts class, but his usual behavior was completely consistent with his fat appearance. He would not stand if he could sit, and he would not move if he could.
Although his obesity is due to the congenital obesity gene, people can't help but think that this guy is so fat because he is lazy.
The two of them were very different in terms of family background and talent. They were supposed to be two parallel worlds that would not intersect. However, they got along very well during the two years of high school and had the same chemistry.
"Part of the touring exhibition of ultra-ancient relics of the Academy of Sciences will be displayed in our school. Aren't you usually most interested in ultra-ancient civilizations? Why don't you go and take a look?" Gao Hongzhi said.
"Relics of super ancient civilization? Okay, let's go take a look!" What Gao Hongzhi said also aroused Chu Yunfan's interest.
When Chu YunWhen Fan and Gao Hongzhi came to the exhibition area specially opened by the school, there was already a sea of ​​people. Although Jinghai No. 13 Middle School was just an ordinary middle school among the dozens of middle schools in Jinghai City, there were tens of thousands of teachers and students in the school, making it a small town. And now these people are heading towards the exhibition area. You can imagine what kind of congestion it will be like.
After the Cataclysm, the research, excavation and restoration of ultra-ancient civilizations became the mainstream of the entire society. The government would often display the relics of some less important ultra-ancient civilizations everywhere.
The relics of the ultra-ancient civilization displayed on this tour to No. 13 are only a very small part of the relics of the ultra-ancient civilization on display this time.
Chu Yunfan and Gao Hongzhi moved slowly with the flow of people. Chu Yunfan stared at the exhibits locked in the tempered glass. There were stone carvings from super-ancient civilizations, incomplete weapons, etc. Although they were cultural relics, their actual value was not very high.
